label: Run / MS levels
caveat: Distinct MS levels recorded; not a quality score.

label: Run time (s)
caveat: RT span from spectra, not LC separation chemistry.

label: MS1 spectra
caveat: Includes scans with no detected peaks.

label: MS1 peaks per scan (quartiles)
caveat: Valid stored peaks per scan, not identified molecular features.

label: MS2 spectra
caveat: Includes scans with no detected peaks.

label: MS2 peaks per scan (quartiles)
caveat: Valid stored peaks per scan, not identified molecular features.

label: DIA isolation windows
caveat: Distinct window geometries; not rounded precursor-target count. DIA evidence and complete metadata required.

label: DIA window widths (min/max)
caveat: Minimum and maximum distinct window widths in m/z; not individual scalar extrema.

label: MS1/MS2 scan ratio
caveat: Undefined when there are no MS2 scans; not a performance score.

label: MS2 scans per acquisition cycle
caveat: MS1-delimited cycles only; not applicable to MS1-free targeted runs.
